item.title: Whiskers 0.8.52
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.52

### Local Dictation Reliability

  • Improved local dictation on low battery so Whiskers avoids background model loading when your Mac is unplugged and nearly out of power
  • Added clearer feedback when local dictation cannot finish because your Mac is under power, heat, or memory pressure

    • ### File Transcription

  • Renamed Bulk Transcription to File Transcription throughout the app for clearer wording

    • ### Hotkeys

  • Fixed double-tap and hold behavior so locked dictation responds more consistently
